description.value: The Questionnaire of Smoking Urges measured subjective craving 15 minutes before scanning and again after the cue-reactivity task. Total post-cue minus pre-cue scores quantified cue-induced change in craving.

spans.text: Fifteen minutes before scanning, participants completed the Questionnaire of Smoking Urges ( ) as a subjective evaluation of their pre–cue exposure craving. In the scanner, participants first completed a 6-minute resting-state scan where they were presented with a blank black screen and given the instruction to keep their eyes open and think of nothing in particular. Participants subsequently performed the smoking cue-reactivity task. Upon exiting the scanner, participants again completed the Questionnaire of Smoking Urges to assess their post–cue exposure craving. The total Questionnaire of Smoking Urges score was used to separately calculate pre– and post–cue exposure craving measures. The total post minus total pre score was then computed to determine cue-induced changes in subjective craving.
